name: Constant-current LED driver
description: Buck/boost LED driver regulating string current with PWM/analog dimming and open/short protection.
electrical_characteristics: Current regulated via a sense resistor
Topology chosen from Vin vs string voltage
Dimming by PWM of the driver
critical_electrical_constraints: String current declared; sense resistor value and power
LED thermal path with vias; junction temperature
stackup_recommendations: 2 layers; metal-core or 2 oz copper for high-power LED arrays
placement_rules: LED driver, inductor and sense resistor as a tight loop
LEDs spread for thermal uniformity; thermal vias under LED pads
Display connector near the controller with the shortest route for the data lines
routing_rules: LED string current paths sized for the drive current
Addressable LED data line with a series resistor at the source; level shifter when the MCU is 3.3 V and the LEDs need 5 V
Display buses (SPI/RGB/MIPI) length matched where the interface requires
copper_ground_requirements: Copper area under each high-power LED for heat spreading
thermal_considerations: LED junction temperature from forward power and thermal path; lumen derating at temperature recorded
emi_emc_considerations: PWM dimming edges filtered on long LED strips
protection_requirements: Open-LED and short-LED protection by the driver; ESD on display connectors
verification_requirements: LED current and forward voltage declared; driver headroom computed
Thermal path computed; strip current sized
manufacturing_constraints: White solder mask for lighting boards; aluminium PCB when the thermal path needs it
unsupported_conditions: String voltage above the driver's output rating
